faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions About Our Assessment Tools

faqs.question: How long does the assessment take?
faqs.answer: The comprehensive organizational health assessment typically takes 15-20 minutes to complete. We recommend setting aside uninterrupted time to ensure thoughtful responses.

faqs.question: Who should take this assessment?
faqs.answer: This assessment is designed for organizational leaders, executives, HR professionals, and anyone responsible for organizational development and cultural transformation.

faqs.question: What will I receive after completing the assessment?
faqs.answer: You'll receive a detailed analysis of your organization's health across five key pillars: Purpose & Culture, People & Development, Structure & Systems, Results & Innovation, and Interconnectivity. The report includes specific recommendations and areas for improvement.

faqs.question: Is my data kept confidential?
faqs.answer: Yes, all assessment data is kept strictly confidential and is only used to generate your personalized results and recommendations. We do not share individual assessment data with third parties.

faqs.question: Can I retake the assessment?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! We encourage organizations to retake the assessment periodically to track progress and measure the impact of implemented changes. This helps you monitor your transformation journey over time.

faqs.question: What if I need help interpreting my results?
faqs.answer: Our team is here to help! After receiving your results, you can schedule a complimentary consultation to discuss your assessment outcomes and explore how COIREA can support your organizational transformation.
